This FloPlast half round external gutter stop end in black offers a practical and easy to install solution for rainwater systems. Constructed from durable uPVC, it is designed for 112mm gutters, providing a secure seal at the end of a gutter run. Ideal for both new build projects and refurbishment applications, this stop end ensures efficient water drainage and prevents leaks. Its compatibility with most major gutter manufacturers makes it a versatile choice for trade professionals seeking reliable rainwater management components for exterior work and roofing projects. The pre-lubricated seals assist in a quick and simple fitting process, reducing labour time on site.
